description: Render a 1200x630 Open Graph image from a template id (see list_templates) and text params such as title and subtitle. Returns the permanent image URL to put in og:image, and whether it was already cached. Optional exp (Unix seconds, paid plans) makes the signed URL expire; leave it out for an og:image URL.

exp.description: Expiry for the signed image URL, in Unix seconds (paid plans); leave it out for a permanent og:image URL.

params.description: Text values for the template's placeholders, such as title and subtitle, keyed by placeholder name.

templateId.description: The id of the template to render (see list_templates).

name: generate_og_image
